crossRefs.note: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the…

translations.web: to the space above the door, even to the inner house, and outside, and by all the wall all around inside and outside, by measure.
translations.bsb: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary on all the walls, spaced evenly around the inner and outer sanctuary,
translations.kjv: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
translations.asv: to the space above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
